verdict: Six requested files fully read. Four bounded test-contract findings; no new production defect established in the selected supporting traces.

findings.problem: No-second-request oracle maps all connection.accept errors to success. A control-stream decoder/protocol/I/O fault can count as proof of no duplicate.
findings.remedy: Keep the finite idle timeout and explicitly understood graceful closure distinct; propagate other typed connection errors. Add an actual H3 malformed-control peer negative plus ordinary no-duplicate positive.
findings.evidence: Exact match arm Ok(_) | Err(_) => Ok(()), while accept returns Result<Option<RequestResolver>, ConnectionError>.
findings.runtime_status: Source-supported; no reproduction executed by reviewer. Root has delegated a bounded fixture remedy.

findings.problem: Aborting/dropping relay or sniffer front owner does not cancel detached downstream/per-packet tasks. They retain Arc UDP sockets until their independent exit or test-runtime teardown.
findings.remedy: Own downstream and delayed-send tasks in local JoinSets, and provide bounded abort/join of owners. Prove actual bidirectional traffic first, then exact owned socket release; propagate meaningful setup/relay faults rather than relying only on timeout.
findings.evidence: Delay relay Vec<JoinHandle> drops without abort; forward_delayed spawns untracked sends; gated relay spawns untracked receivers; HelloSniffer Drop aborts only front task.
findings.runtime_status: Source-supported by resolved Tokio detach contract; no surviving-resource runtime measurement by reviewer. No production client or cross-process leak claimed.

findings.problem: Different ephemeral UDP relay addresses are used to prove a fresh SOCKS association even though the first socket has already been dropped before the second bind(0). Port reuse is allowed.
findings.remedy: Use the exact two accepted TCP/control associations and independently positive datagram observations already present; remove the unguaranteed address-inequality condition or hold explicit generation identity. Do not add retries or weaker thresholds.
findings.evidence: Proxy sequentially awaits the first relay helper then opens the second; helper owns its relay socket by value and returns only observation metadata.
findings.runtime_status: Source-supported portability assumption; not an observed flake. A controlled allocator-reuse mutation can demonstrate the unnecessary failure.

findings.problem: Rejection/resend test never observes 0-RTT dispatch or a rejection-triggered resend. Its three path/status/connection assertions also describe three ordinary full-handshake requests. A fixed 150 ms reply delay does not justify the module claim always.
findings.remedy: Extend the existing rejection test with a closed reply gate or early-data span-state observations tied to peer rejection and the same-connection result. Qualify delay-only prose. Do not add a mirrored test merely to increase count.
findings.evidence: early_data_client enables early data, but the test asserts only three served paths, successful statuses, and no extra stream/connection. Disabling that switch leaves its stated assertions unchanged; the separate gated acceptance test does not prove rejection replay.
findings.runtime_status: Proposed disable-early-data mutation is not executed; this is a scoped proof gap, not a claimed production replay defect.

per_file_assessments.assessment: The actual roster includes every selected test file; HTTPS-record modules are feature gated, and support is shared via its existing path. No unexpected feature exposure or module split needed.

Closed-gate GET versus POST and raced GET assert peer arrivals before/after handshake replies, not only timers. POST body replay checks exact bytes; timeout checks typed Connect phase; concurrent requests all finish and peer connection count is exactly one. Delay-only rejection evidence, absence oracle and relay ownership need the listed corrections. Named browser comments are recipe context, not newly verified browser captures.

Refusals occur before request dispatch, response metadata counts setup retry exactly, server path count is one and both association legs have positive traffic. Windows refused TCP allowance is explicit. Trace-before-listen synchronization still depends on arming the listener within the configured delay; no universal scheduler guarantee is claimed. Address inequality is not a fresh-association contract.

Peer-side stateful store counts initial zero then positive presented/accepted tickets. Direct-versus-SOCKS and outer-proxy-versus-origin controls use shared server names and independent stores, exposing cross-cache contamination. Wire sniffer requires exact nonzero ClientHello counts and PSK offer transitions. It parses a selected owned-client Initial/CRYPTO shape, not all hostile QUIC input; downstream task ownership is incomplete.

Four route/DNS/auth/Alt-Used variants require exact one origin and one alternative request, logical origin authority/SNI, both authenticated legs and nonzero UDP counters. Bounded SOCKS parsers preserve literal/domain form and handle normal ConnectionAborted through shared peer-gone classification. The unsupported-route negative checks a specific typed preflight failure; it does not independently observe an unused port. Local fixture handles join on success; early failure relies on per-test runtime shutdown.

The successful refused-QUIC fallback independently receives POST/path/payload on H2 through SOCKS CONNECT, reports H2 with zero setup-retry count, and requires traffic on the failed UDP leg. Rejected association expects typed Proxy and H3, with no new proxy/TCP/QUIC attempts during bounded 300 ms windows. Those windows are finite observations, not perpetual absence. Joined success and per-test timeout bound the fixtures.

prior_coverage_handling: Existing credited composition/review artifacts were retained. These newly full-read test files were pending in the parent inventory; support/production records carry their actual current partial ranges, with no old coverage promoted.
limitations: No Cargo, test execution or runtime measurements in this pass. Existing test-success history does not close source coverage or reproduce these candidates.
Six full test reads cover 2900 lines and their fixture/error paths, not every module in main.rs.
Selected production traces establish route/cache/replay/timeout predicates and ownership structure only; they are not full production-file reviews.

Admission saturation, cancellation of caller requests, all discovery/ECH branches, all auth failures, dynamic QPACK variants and arbitrary remote parser inputs are not exhaustively covered by these tests.
The gated early-data controls are stronger than delay-only controls; 300 ms or one-second quiet observations remain finite.

Some top-level test/server handles are only joined on success; outer timeout/error paths rely on the isolated test runtime shutdown. This is retained as a limitation, not a claim of production leakage.
No whole architecture-audit completion or final integration approval.
